basic_info.description: Move-in ready perfection awaits at this spectacular detached 3/2 Midtown Terrace gem w/ no homes across street - just Greenbelt! Completely transformed w/ freshly refinished hardwood floors & open layout featuring expansive kitchen w/ SubZero fridge, Poggenpohl cabinets, Viking 6-burner cooktop & Cambria quartz counters. Living/dining area w/ stone accent wall & fireplace offers many flexible layouts. The upstairs bath has dual rain showers, radiant-heat floors,Toto washlets & floating dual-vanity. Two rear bedrooms overlook newly landscaped vertical garden w/ irrigation & lighting. Also upstairs: new 3-zone heat pump/AC, surround sound, Hunter Douglas electric shades. Lower level (2015 new foundation/drainage) offers office/flex room w/ built-in adjustable desk/media console accessed from interior stairs, garage, or sliding doors opening to sheltered rear yard & patio. Bedroom suite stuns w/built-in queen bed w/storage, lux 5-star bathroom & walk-in closet. Also down: radiant-heat floors & stacked W/D. Premium finishes: newer roof (2020), updated electrical, Marvin windows, Beronio doors, epoxy garage floor. Discover this serene retreat w/quick access to LH hike/bike trails & urban convenience just minutes to Castro, BART/280, Forest Hill muni & more.
